title: Published seed administrator credentials can enable full administrative takeover
evidence: README.md:42-55 directs DatabaseSeeder execution and publishes admin credentials; app/Database/Seeds/DatabaseSeeder.php:9-14 calls ContentSeeder; app/Database/Seeds/ContentSeeder.php:16-31 creates the active admin; app/Config/Routes.php:89-118 protects administrative actions with that role.
issue: The documented provisioning path creates a publicly known administrator credential.
impact: An unauthenticated user can gain full administration if production used the standard seed path.
reproduction: Provision with the documented seeder, authenticate with the documented account, then visit /admin.
root_cause: Demo identities are included in the general production seeder and documentation.
recommended_remediation: Separate development fixtures, bootstrap production admins from secrets, rotate/delete all seeded accounts, and block demo identities in production.
verification_criteria: Production provisioning creates no predictable accounts and the documented credentials cannot authenticate.

title: Payment confirmation is not bound to the persisted Razorpay order or independently reconciled
evidence: app/Controllers/Checkout/Checkout.php:124-142 selects a local order then calls markPaid after signature verification; app/Libraries/Payment/RazorpayPaymentService.php:106-120 verifies only submitted HMAC fields; app/Services/OrderService.php:123-127 does not persist provider_order and :137-143 lacks amount/currency/provider-reference/state conditions; payment schema provides provider_order at migration :79-98.
issue: A valid signature is not tied to the selected local order, expected amount/currency/capture state, or a unique payment reference; replays are accepted.
impact: Orders may be falsely marked paid or multiple orders associated with one payment, breaking fulfillment and reconciliation.
reproduction: Submit a valid merchant Razorpay response for another gateway order while resolving a different pending local order; no gateway-order equality or remote capture check is made. Replay the same payload to repeat the paid/history update.
root_cause: Gateway order creation is detached from payment persistence and browser callback data is treated as authoritative.
recommended_remediation: Persist/compare gateway order ID, verify captured payment amount/currency/status server-to-server or via authenticated webhooks, enforce unique provider payment IDs, and transition only pending payments atomically.
verification_criteria: Mismatched, failed, wrong-amount, wrong-currency, duplicate, and replayed callbacks make no local change; one matching captured payment updates one pending order once.

title: Inventory conditional decrements can fail silently, enabling oversell
evidence: app/Services/OrderService.php:41-57 performs an initial stock read; :104-109 makes conditional decrements without checking affected rows; :129-134 commits absent SQL errors; :51-53 also bypasses rejection when non-made-to-order stock is zero.
issue: Concurrent checkouts can pass a prior stock read, then one conditional update affects zero rows while its order still commits.
impact: Oversold stock and orders with no matching inventory decrement.
reproduction: Submit concurrent last-unit checkouts; one update fails its stock predicate but the code commits its order. Set an in_stock item to zero and observe the shown precheck does not reject it.
root_cause: Read-then-write inventory logic lacks checked atomic reservation outcomes and explicit zero-stock semantics.
recommended_remediation: Use conditional reservation/decrement with affected-row validation in a transaction, roll back all related writes on failure, and define unlimited versus made-to-order semantics.
verification_criteria: Parallel final-stock attempts accept at most one reservation/order and failed reservations leave no order/coupon/payment effect.

title: Coupon dates, limits, and concurrency are not enforced at checkout
evidence: app/Services/CartService.php:296-315 checks dates/count only at apply time; app/Services/OrderService.php:168-188 omits dates/global/per-user limits and :112-118 increments used_count unconditionally; CouponModel.php:19-24 filters only active code.
issue: Final checkout revalidation omits important eligibility rules and usage consumption is not conditional or atomic.
impact: Expired, exhausted, or per-user-limited discounts can be applied and simultaneous orders can exceed campaign limits.
reproduction: Apply a code before it expires or exhausts, then complete checkout after that change; the shown final verification still returns a discount. Run concurrent final-slot checkouts.
root_cause: Cart validation is relied upon as final authorization and consumption has no predicate/affected-row check.
recommended_remediation: Revalidate dates/global/per-user limits during checkout and atomically reserve/consume with checked conditional updates.
verification_criteria: Expired, exhausted, per-user, cancellation/retry, and concurrent last-slot cases fail safely without counter drift.

title: Order lifecycle permits arbitrary transitions and lacks cancellation/refund recovery
evidence: app/Controllers/Admin/Orders.php:70-80 accepts any listed status; app/Services/OrderService.php:152-162 only updates status/history; no reviewed route/service invokes a provider refund, validates refund amounts, or restores stock. app/Views/frontend/return_and_refunds.php:19-38 displays policy promises.
issue: Status changes are not a state machine and have no required financial/inventory side effects.
impact: Invalid fulfillment states, unrefunded payments, and inconsistent stock handling can cause financial loss and disputes.
reproduction: An administrator submits cancelled for a shipped order or changes any status in the allowlist; only a status/history update occurs.
root_cause: Lifecycle business rules and side effects are not modeled centrally.
recommended_remediation: Implement explicit allowed transitions with one-time refund and inventory restoration operations, and dedicated cancellation/return records.
verification_criteria: Invalid transitions fail; valid cancellation/refund flows produce one auditable provider and stock effect.

title: Checkout submissions have no server-side idempotency
evidence: app/Controllers/Checkout/Checkout.php:46-118 invokes order creation for each accepted POST; app/Services/OrderService.php:65-127 creates unique orders/items/stock/coupon/payment effects; no idempotency key or unique request record exists. app/Views/checkout/index.php:132-136 provides only a client-side disabled button.
issue: Retries, duplicate tabs, or parallel requests can create separate orders from the same cart.
impact: Duplicate orders, inventory reservations, coupons, and gateway intents.
reproduction: Send two valid checkout POSTs with the same cart/session before a cart-clear path; each generates a fresh order number and writes effects.
root_cause: No persisted checkout idempotency contract or cart lock exists.
recommended_remediation: Persist a unique idempotency key/request fingerprint and return the prior order for retries; lock/reserve the cart transactionally.
verification_criteria: Duplicate/parallel equivalent requests produce one order and one stock/coupon/payment effect.

title: Password recovery is nonfunctional and login has no visible brute-force control
evidence: app/Controllers/Auth/Auth.php:94-105 returns a neutral reset message but creates no token or delivery; Routes.php:65-71 has no reset-confirm endpoint; Auth.php:21-48 has no throttle/lockout and no rate-limit implementation was found in app.
issue: Users cannot reset passwords and repeated login guesses are not controlled in application code.
impact: Support burden and greater credential-stuffing/brute-force risk.
reproduction: Submit forgot-password for a valid account; the response claims delivery but no reset state exists. Repeat failed login requests without a visible throttle.
root_cause: Recovery and abuse controls remain placeholders.
recommended_remediation: Implement hashed expiring one-use reset tokens, mail delivery, adaptive per-IP/account throttles, audit logs, and admin MFA where suitable.
verification_criteria: Reset is one-use/expiring/non-enumerating and failed-login bursts are throttled.

title: No payment method is usable without Razorpay configuration despite documented COD fallback
evidence: app/Libraries/Payment/PaymentManager.php:14-28 adds Razorpay only and comments out COD; Checkout.php:62-65 rejects unavailable methods; README.md:81-84 and :93-95 state COD works out of the box.
issue: Default installation offers no method when Razorpay keys are absent.
impact: The core checkout purchase flow is unavailable.
reproduction: Run without Razorpay keys, open checkout, and submit a method; manager lookup returns null.
root_cause: COD was disabled without a replacement or matching documentation.
recommended_remediation: Enable and test COD with eligibility rules or clearly require an online provider and fail deployment readiness when none is enabled.
verification_criteria: A clean staging environment exposes and completes one approved payment method.

title: Production hardening relies on unset overrides; HTTPS and CSP are off by default
evidence: app/Config/App.php:19,136,160,201 sets HTTP localhost URL, UTC, forceGlobalSecureRequests false, CSPEnabled false; app/Config/Database.php:27-52 defaults DBDebug true and encrypt false; env is a commented template and no IaC/proxy configuration was present.
issue: Deployment safety depends on manual configuration not enforced by the repository.
impact: Misconfiguration can expose HTTP sessions, debug data, weak XSS containment, or unencrypted remote DB transport.
reproduction: Deploy without overrides; application does not force HTTPS or enable CSP.
root_cause: Development defaults are not backed by production startup validation/runbooks.
recommended_remediation: Add required production configuration validation for HTTPS/HSTS, proxy trust, secure cookies, debug off, CSP, DB TLS, health/monitoring/backups, and migration rollback.
verification_criteria: Staging rejects unsafe config and validates HTTPS/security headers/debug suppression/restore procedures.

title: Razorpay secret is stored in plaintext application settings
evidence: app/Controllers/Admin/Settings.php:10-18 includes razorpay_key_secret and :28-35 persists it; CreateContentTables.php:131-143 defines settings.value as text; RazorpayPaymentService.php:17-21 reads it as the secret.
issue: A payment signing secret is stored as ordinary database-backed CMS configuration.
impact: Database/backups/settings access can disclose a secret used to validate payments.
reproduction: A database reader can query the settings row; no external secret reference or application-layer encryption is used.
root_cause: Secret management is coupled to editable settings.
recommended_remediation: Use a managed secret store/environment injection, remove secret display/editing from settings, rotate existing keys, and redact gateway logs.
verification_criteria: No DB export/settings UI contains a usable secret and a rotated runtime-injected key works.

title: Admin video uploads lack robust media processing safeguards
evidence: app/Controllers/Admin/Products.php:388-432 routes video MIME types to storeUserVideo; :480-504 allows 64 MB files after MIME/extension checks and stores originals publicly, unlike re-encoded image processing in app/Services/ImageUploadService.php:30-82.
issue: Video content is not signature-inspected, duration/codec constrained, transcoded, quarantined, or asynchronously processed.
impact: Storage/bandwidth/parser reliability risk, amplified by admin compromise.
reproduction: Upload a 64 MB allowed-type video; its original is placed in public uploads without processing policy.
root_cause: Video path bypasses the hardened image pipeline.
recommended_remediation: Quarantine/inspect/transcode asynchronously with codec, duration, resolution, and storage-delivery controls.
verification_criteria: Malformed/disallowed media is rejected and valid media is processed before public availability.

title: Cart drawer interpolates server data into HTML without escaping
evidence: public/assets/js/cart.js:5-24 interpolates URL/image/name/variant strings into HTML and :45 assigns innerHTML; app/Services/CartService.php:236-250 supplies product/variant-derived fields.
issue: Catalog strings are parsed as HTML in shopper browsers.
impact: Stored XSS is possible if malicious catalog data is introduced through admin, import, or a future seller path.
reproduction: Store an HTML/event-handler payload in a product name, add it to cart, and open the drawer; the template parser receives it.
recommended_remediation: Use textContent/property assignment or context-specific escaping and validate URL protocols; add regression tests and CSP defense in depth.
verification_criteria: HTML/script/URL payloads render inertly in every cart field.

title: Automated test coverage does not cover commerce or security-critical flows
evidence: Only tests/unit/HealthTest.php, tests/session/ExampleSessionTest.php, and tests/database/ExampleDatabaseTest.php are starter tests. phpunit.dist.xml:4 expects vendor PHPUnit, but php vendor/bin/phpunit failed because the file is absent.
issue: Critical behavior has no regression coverage and the supplied test runner is incomplete.
impact: Financial/security defects can recur unnoticed and release confidence is low.
reproduction: Run php vendor/bin/phpunit --testdox; it exits because vendor/bin/phpunit is missing.
root_cause: Starter tests remained and local dev dependencies are incomplete.
recommended_remediation: Restore reproducible dev dependencies and add MySQL/test-gateway integration, concurrency, authorization, and lifecycle test suites in CI.
verification_criteria: CI executes targeted tests for all critical checkout/payment/inventory/auth paths.

title: Transactional notifications and customer cancellation/return requests are absent
evidence: No application email send, notification, queue, scheduler, cancellation route, or return-request route was found. Routes.php:54-60 and :76-84 cover checkout/account without those actions.
issue: Orders and service requests have no implemented customer communications or self-service/request flow.
impact: No receipts/status updates and manual dispute handling despite displayed policy content.
reproduction: Review order creation/status paths and account routes; no sender or request handler is invoked/exposed.
root_cause: Operational customer-service workflows are not implemented.
recommended_remediation: Implement outbox/queue-backed notifications and authenticated cancellation/return requests after lifecycle policy approval.
verification_criteria: Test events deliver once and eligible customers can submit governed requests.
